note: Elements with a computed backdrop-filter (this WebKit build computes it but paints no blur, see lib/check-backdrop-filter.mjs). layers = all with a backdrop-filter in the document; visible = intersecting the viewport; visArea = their on-screen px² summed (overlaps counted twice). chrome = fixed/sticky (self or ancestor), a chrome name (tabbar, topbar, sheet, pill, toolbar, nav …), a nav/header/dialog tag or a dialog/navigation/toolbar/tablist role; everything else is content.
